from pathlib import Path

Path("kernel.py").write_text(
    """import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.experimental.pallas as pl

def workload(x_ref, y_ref, o_ref):
    x = x_ref[...]
    y = y_ref[...]
    o_ref[...] = jax.nn.silu(x) * y

@jax.jit
def kernel(x, y):
    return pl.pallas_call(
        workload,
        out_shape=jax.ShapeDtypeStruct.like(x),
        grid=(x.shape[0],),
        in_specs=[
            pl.BlockSpec((1, x.shape[1]), lambda i: (i, 0)),
            pl.BlockSpec((1, x.shape[1]), lambda i: (i, 0)),
        ],
        out_specs=pl.BlockSpec((1, x.shape[1]), lambda i: (i, 0)),
    )(x, y)
""",
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```<|end_message|><|message_model|><|content_text|>```mswea_bash_command
python dev_check.py kernel.py
```<|end_message|><|content_model_end_sampling|>
